parent: uncompressed A native controller and unchanged original 51 membrane operator bases
limitation: Six dense factorizations per accepted midpoint trial and a shared minimum step across 1557 cells dominate membrane arithmetic.
method: RA34PW2 Rosenbrock-W 3(2), four stages, one frozen block-diagonal approximate Jacobian per trial. Full voltage/gate coupling remains in every RHS. The approximate W matrix omits cross voltage/gate Jacobian blocks explicitly; no gates are removed or equilibrated.
source: PETSc v3.24.5 rosw.c RA34PW2 tableau; Rang and Angermann 2005. Method coefficients, transformed stages and cubic dense output are preserved.
operation: Factor C/(gamma*h)+K(g0) once, solve four stage RHS; solve gate diagonal blocks; embedded error against same V_ATOL=2e-5 mV and G_ATOL=2e-7; dense output at integer half-step and endpoint feeds existing physical event commits.
legal_information: Current physical voltage/gates, model matrices, prescribed instantaneous conductance/current, physical timestep only.
novelty: Known numerical method, new engineering adapter; no novel biological mechanism claimed.
event_change_risk: Accepted timesteps and dense midpoint voltage can differ; exact event counts and timestamped event function comparisons required before any promotion.
falsifier: Method order/reference error fails, dense midpoint gates invalid, event counts or whole-state fixed short screen fails, or complete wall time does not improve.
control: Original midpoint scheme and independent CPU Radau reference, same initial physical state and inputs. No compression or low precision in this prototype.
budget: Second and last complete numerical prototype of existing PLAN.json; consumes existing 16 runs/16 operator checks/5400 s; no added budget.
